report:
Based on the provided financial disclosures and earnings reports, here is the quarter-by-quarter synthesis of Microsoft's GAAP financial performance from December 31, 2024, through September 30, 2026. The analysis strictly adheres to the explicit figures reported in the referenced documents, noting where specific GAAP metrics were disclosed versus where they were absent or only partially detailed.

### Quarter-by-Quarter Financial Analysis

**1. Quarter Ended December 31, 2024 (FY25 Q2)**
Microsoft reported strong top-line growth driven by cloud and AI demand. GAAP revenue reached $69.6 billion, marking a 12% year-over-year increase `[[9]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/investor/earnings/fy-2025-q2/press-release-webcast)[[11]](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/content/microsoftcorp/PressReleaseFY25Q2)`. GAAP net income stood at $24.1 billion, reflecting a 10% growth `[[11]](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/content/microsoftcorp/PressReleaseFY25Q2)[[12]](https://www.analystlens.com/stocks/msft/10q/fy2025-q2)`. GAAP diluted earnings per share (EPS) was reported at $3.23 `[[12]](https://www.analystlens.com/stocks/msft/10q/fy2025-q2)`. It is important to note that these results were weighed down by net losses from OpenAI investments, which reduced net income and diluted EPS by $939 million and $0.12, respectively `[[10]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2026/01/28/microsoft-cloud-and-ai-strength-drives-second-quarter-results-3/)`.

**2. Quarter Ended March 31, 2025 (FY25 Q3)**
Revenue grew to $70.1 billion, representing a 13% year-over-year increase `[[2]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2025-Q3/press-release-webcast)[[4]](https://www.cnbc.com/2025/04/30/microsoft-msft-q3-earnings-report-2025.html)`. GAAP net income climbed 18% to $25.8 billion `[[4]](https://www.cnbc.com/2025/04/30/microsoft-msft-q3-earnings-report-2025.html)[[58]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2025-Q3/press-release-webcast)`. GAAP diluted EPS was reported at $3.46 `[[58]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2025-Q3/press-release-webcast)`. Microsoft Cloud revenue specifically surged to $42.4 billion, up 20% year-over-year, highlighting the continued monetization of differentiated AI offerings `[[3]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2025/04/30/microsoft-cloud-and-ai-strength-drives-third-quarter-results-2/)`.

**3. Quarter Ended June 30, 2025 (FY25 Q4)**
Microsoft closed fiscal year 2025 with robust performance. GAAP revenue reached $76.4 billion, an 18% increase from the prior year `[[23]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/investor/earnings/fy-2025-q4/press-release-webcast)[[24]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2025/07/30/microsoft-cloud-and-ai-strength-fuels-fourth-quarter-results/)`. GAAP net income expanded significantly by 24% to $27.2 billion `[[24]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2025/07/30/microsoft-cloud-and-ai-strength-fuels-fourth-quarter-results/)[[26]](https://fortune.com/2025/07/30/microsoft-earnings-blowout-fourth-quarter-4-trillion-market-cap-ai/)`. GAAP diluted EPS was $3.65, also up 24% year-over-year `[[27]](https://www.studioglobal.ai/discover/answers/what-were-the-key-figures-from-microsoft-s-6a6aa060ee134d62dbe77fa8)[[86]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2025/07/30/microsoft-cloud-and-ai-strength-fuels-fourth-quarter-results/)`. Azure cloud growth accelerated to 39%, underscoring the strength of the company's intelligent cloud segment `[[27]](https://www.studioglobal.ai/discover/answers/what-were-the-key-figures-from-microsoft-s-6a6aa060ee134d62dbe77fa8)`.

**4. Quarter Ended September 30, 2025 (FY26 Q1)**
Entering fiscal year 2026, Microsoft delivered revenue of $77.67 billion, beating analyst estimates by over $2 billion `[[20]](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2025-10-29-microsoft-co-stock/)[[165]](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2025-10-29-microsoft-co-stock/)`. GAAP diluted EPS was reported at $4.13, surpassing consensus expectations `[[20]](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2025-10-29-microsoft-co-stock/)[[165]](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2025-10-29-microsoft-co-stock/)`. While headline net income was not explicitly itemized in the provided references, the quarter was notably impacted by $3.1 billion in net losses from OpenAI investments, which decreased net income and diluted EPS by $3.1 billion and $0.41, respectively `[[15]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q1/performance)[[68]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q1/performance)`.

**5. Quarter Ended December 31, 2025 (FY26 Q2)**
Revenue continued its upward trajectory to $81.273 billion, a 17% year-over-year growth `[[13]](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/microsoft-corporation-reports-earnings-results-for-the-second-quarter-and-six-months-ended-december-ce7e5bdedb8df52c)[[42]](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/MSFT/10-q-microsoft-corp-quarterly-earnings-report-b6f537ec392a.html)`. GAAP net income saw substantial expansion, rising 60% to $38.458 billion `[[13]](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/microsoft-corporation-reports-earnings-results-for-the-second-quarter-and-six-months-ended-december-ce7e5bdedb8df52c)[[65]](https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:1b99ae42be341:0-microsoft-q2-2026-financial-results/)`. While basic EPS was disclosed at $5.18 `[[13]](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/microsoft-corporation-reports-earnings-results-for-the-second-quarter-and-six-months-ended-december-ce7e5bdedb8df52c)`, the exact GAAP diluted EPS figure was not explicitly provided in the referenced documents. The quarter benefited from a $7.6 billion net gain from OpenAI investments, which increased net income and diluted EPS by $7.6 billion and $1.02, respectively `[[59]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q2/press-release-webcast)[[60]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2026/01/28/microsoft-cloud-and-ai-strength-drives-second-quarter-results-3/)`.

**6. Quarter Ended March 31, 2026 (FY26 Q3)**
Microsoft reported GAAP revenue of $82.9 billion, an 18% increase year-over-year `[[29]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q3/press-release-webcast)[[81]](https://www.techpowerup.com/348650/microsoft-announces-third-quarter-fiscal-2026-results)`. GAAP net income grew 23% to $31.8 billion `[[34]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/microsoft-reports-23-increase-net-091303218.html?fr=sycsrp%5Fcatchall)[[77]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q3/press-release-webcast)`. GAAP diluted EPS reached $4.27, also up 23% `[[35]](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-4-29-microsoft-co-stock/)[[77]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q3/press-release-webcast)`. Prior year comparables were negatively impacted by $583 million in OpenAI investment losses, which decreased net income and diluted EPS by $583 million and $0.08, respectively `[[78]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q3/performance)`.

**7. Quarter Ended June 30, 2026 (FY26 Q4)**
Closing fiscal year 2026, Microsoft achieved record quarterly revenue of $90.0 billion, up 18% year-over-year `[[54]](https://www.techpowerup.com/351206/microsoft-announces-fourth-quarter-fiscal-year-2026-results)[[95]](https://www.markets.com/news/microsoft-earnings-q4-fy-2026)`. GAAP net income climbed 31% to $35.8 billion `[[91]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q4/press-release-webcast)[[95]](https://www.markets.com/news/microsoft-earnings-q4-fy-2026)`. GAAP diluted EPS increased 32% to $4.81 `[[53]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/microsoft-msft-q4-earnings-report-2026.html)[[95]](https://www.markets.com/news/microsoft-earnings-q4-fy-2026)`. The quarter was influenced by discrete items that provided a $0.27 benefit to diluted EPS compared to forward guidance `[[52]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2026/07/29/microsoft-cloud-and-ai-strength-fuels-fourth-quarter-results-4/)[[93]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2026/07/29/microsoft-cloud-and-ai-strength-fuels-fourth-quarter-results-4/)`.

**8. Quarter Ended September 30, 2026 (FY27 Q1)**
Microsoft opened fiscal year 2027 with GAAP revenue of $92.279 billion, representing a 19% year-over-year increase `[[48]](https://www.cashandchaos.com/guides/microsoft-q1-2027-earnings-azure-capex-free-cash-flow)[[73]](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/MSFT/8-k-microsoft-corp-reports-material-event-1d104ec399c6.html)`. GAAP net income rose 32% to $36.629 billion `[[73]](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/MSFT/8-k-microsoft-corp-reports-material-event-1d104ec399c6.html)[[157]](https://www.macrotrends.net/stocks/charts/MSFT/microsoft/net-income)`. GAAP diluted EPS reached $4.92, up 32% year-over-year `[[46]](https://stockmarkethours.org/events/microsoft-earnings)[[73]](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/MSFT/8-k-microsoft-corp-reports-material-event-1d104ec399c6.html)`. Azure revenue growth accelerated dramatically to 48%, solidifying it as a primary growth engine `[[48]](https://www.cashandchaos.com/guides/microsoft-q1-2027-earnings-azure-capex-free-cash-flow)[[100]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/28/microsoft-msft-q1-earnings-report-2027.html)`.
